label: CORE-FP-OPERAND-C-CUT
title: Core FP/NEON operand_c forwarding critical-path cut
model_selection: spawn_agent 省略 model；用户已确认平台默认通道为 gpt-5.6-luna[max]

review.model_selection: spawn_agent 省略 model；用户已确认平台默认通道为 gpt-5.6-luna[max]
review.scope: 只读检查 task JSON、T-047 handoff、rtl/lcvex_core.sv 与 owner diff；仅报告阻断性架构/流水线/验证风险

scope: 针对 full-FP signoff top-1 `soc|core|exmem_valid -> soc|core|idex_d.neon_fp_operand_c[17]`（27 逻辑级、22.660 ns、slack -2.759 ns）切断核心 FP/NEON V 寄存器转发到 ID/EX operand_c 的组合路径；允许采用受控 RAW stall、提前寄存选择或等价切级，不允许 SDC false_path，不回退既有 FP/核心/EMIF 切级成果。

l0: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- make VERILATOR_JOBS=1 compile
l1: 受影响的 core/FP/NEON SV 与 Cocotb 定向测试通过
新增或扩展 operand_c back-to-back RAW/stall 定向覆盖
l2: p7-1-fp-scalar-sequence 与 p7-3-neon-fp 中受影响定向锁步通过；若环境阻断则记录精确原因并保留 L1 证据

acceptance: 实现切断 exmem_valid 到 ID/EX FP/NEON operand_c 的同拍组合转发依赖，架构状态仍仅在 commit 更新，FP/NEON RAW、load-use、transaction kill/backpressure 与顺序提交语义不变；compile、定向 SV/Cocotb 与可运行的 L2 通过；不得用 false_path、关闭断言或修改参考结果。物理改善由后续独立 FP-P5 rerun 确认。
known_limits: 本任务不运行 Quartus full-FP flow、不修改 QSF/SDC、不生成 assembler/SOF、不接触 QEMU fork
切断组合前递可能为相关 FP/NEON 指令增加气泡；必须以定向测试和锁步证明语义正确
next: 集成后派发独立 FP-P5 rerun round13；只有所有 signoff timing 类别全绿才允许 assembler/SOF

integrator_review.notes: Owner implementation and evidence merged. Integrator reran compile, P7-4 Cocotb 6/6, P7-1 sequence 388/388, P7-3 NEON FP 48/48 and registry consistency on merge_sha; all passed.

blockers: EX/MEM V forwarding cut must cover every scalar FP, NEON FP and NEON integer producer/source dependency including FMLA/FMLS third source and V31
new RAW hazard must gate stall_id and fetch_fifo_pop without gating fp_rsp_ready
fp_load_use and transaction kill/commit ordering must remain intact
review_dispatch.known_adjacent_risk: Existing irq_taken handling may not uniformly squash younger ID/EX and EX/MEM state; T-048 must not claim or silently expand into this fix. Track separately.

final_review.notes: V-source coverage, hazards, FIFO/flush and FP response/commit/backpressure review passed; physical STA remains for round13.
